consent.subtitle: As per DPDPA 2023 (Digital Personal Data Protection Act)

consent.why_desc:
Your data is collected strictly for:
• Account creation and authentication
• Preventing unauthorized access and fraud
• Providing banking and financial services
• Sending important alerts and notifications

We DO NOT sell or share your data with third parties for marketing purposes.
consent.rights_desc:
✓ Right to Access — you can view your stored data
✓ Right to Correct — you can update incorrect data
✓ Right to Erase — you can request account deletion
✓ Right to Withdraw — you may withdraw consent at any time by contacting us

Data Fiduciary: Samvya Rural Banking Platform
Contact: privacy@samvya.in
consent.agreement: I have read and understood the data privacy notice. I voluntarily give my informed consent to Samvya to collect and process my personal data as described above, in compliance with DPDPA 2023.
consent.sure_msg: You must accept the consent to use Samvya. Without it, we cannot verify your identity or protect your account.
